map.阶跃稳态误差（e_ss = 1 / (1 + K_p)） 使用指南: Step Steady-State Error (e_ss = 1 / (1 + K_p)) User Guide
map.输入比例增益 Kp，按 e_ss = 1/(1+Kp) 计算 0 型单位反馈系统: Enter the proportional gain Kp and compute the steady-state error of a type 0 unity-feedback system under a unit step as e_ss = 1/(1+Kp), for control system accuracy analysis.
map.0 型单位反馈系统在单位阶跃输入下的稳态误差。: The steady-state error of a type 0 unity-feedback system under a unit step input.
map.比例控制 Kp 求单位阶跃稳态误差 ess = 1/(1+Kp)。: Proportional control Kp gives the unit-step steady-state error ess = 1/(1+Kp).
map.对比不同 Kp 的静差。: Compare the steady-state error at different Kp.
map.：稳态误差 ess = 1/(1+9) = 0.10，即终值偏差 10%；Kp: : steady-state error ess = 1/(1+9) = 0.10, a 10% final-value deviation; raising Kp to 99 brings ess to about 1%.
map.：纯比例必有静差，加入积分可使阶跃 ess 趋于 0，但可能影响稳定性。: Pure proportional control always leaves steady-state error; adding integral action drives the step ess toward 0 but may affect stability.

map.为什么纯比例有静差？: Why Does Pure Proportional Control Have Steady-State Error?
map.为维持输出需一定误差驱动控制器，零误差则无驱动，故存在稳态偏差。: Sustaining the output requires some error to drive the controller; with zero error there is no drive, so a steady-state offset exists.
map.Kp 越大静差越小？: Does a Larger Kp Reduce the Steady-State Error?
map.是，ess=1/(1+Kp) 随 Kp 增大而减小，但过大会引发振荡。: Yes, ess = 1/(1+Kp) falls as Kp grows, but too large a value causes oscillation.
